items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: Jean Laflotte, he was from Paris, France. He writes this in French. He couldn't speak English, but talking about a cyclist.

ctx.x: I wonder. Can I see it first?

This was ITE, Circuit Breaker Corporation. I played many, many jobs for them all over the country. I went to the Diplomat Hotel for them. Jean Laflotte, he was from Paris, France. He writes this in French. He couldn't speak English, but talking about a cyclist. This was at the Blue Room, February the 5th, 1950.
This says from 5.30 PM, Tuesday, March 10th, but it doesn't give a year. Yeah. Well, we can figure it out pretty much. Would this be 50s or?
